office_does: A county commissioner is one of the board members who adopt Spokane County's budget and tax levels and oversee county roads, jails and buildings.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Amber Waldref (Prefers Democratic Party), a commissioner since 2023, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Incumbent Spokane County Commissioner (District 2) since 2023 and former Spokane City Council member (2010-2017); the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Commissioner since 2023; Spokane City Council 2010-2017 and past chair of the Spokane Regional Health District and Spokane Transit Authority boards [S1]
Priorities: the opioid crisis, more housing through smart growth, reducing homelessness and protecting drinking water [S1]
Calls for investment in substance treatment and fixing the justice system [S1]
